header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Ashraf Ali Panhwar, advocate for the petitioners a/w petitioners
Mr. Ghulamullah Memon, A.A.G a/w I.O of crime No.134/2026 of P.S Jhol
Mr. Francis Lucas Khokhar advocate files Vakalatnama on behalf of respondent
body: No.5, which is taken on record.
Through the instant petition, the petitioners have sought quashment of F.I.R bearing Crime No.134 of 2026, registered under Sections 365-B and 34 P.P.C at Police Jhol, District Sanghar.

Investigation officer of Crime No.134 of 2026 is present and has recorded the statement of petitioner No.2, wherein she straightaway submits that she being sui juris lady, after getting divorce from her former husband, has contracted marriage with petitioner No.1 Shoaib Ali s/o Ghulam Qadir Khaskheli with her own free will and without any coercion. She further submits that she was not kidnapped by anyone.

After recording statement of petitioner No.2, the investigation officer submits that he will submit summary for disposal of aforementioned F.I.R under cancelled “C” class before the court having jurisdiction.

In view of above, learned counsel for the petitioners is satisfied and seeks disposal of instant Petition; which is hereby disposed of with directions to the investigation officer to submit such report (as suggested by him) before the court having jurisdiction within 15 days. Official respondents are directed to provide protection to the petitioners in accordance with law.
